## PR 305

**Master switch**

Each agent card gets its own "keep running even when AI is off" switch (`POST /api/admin/ai {key, keepOnWhenMasterOff}`, KeepOnSwitch, audited, idempotent) — a property of every agent, confirmed for Photoshoot but, as the owner said, "as with any agent". `workingNow` is now true whenever an agent is on AND (the master switch is on OR it is kept on); the status pill says "kept on" when that is why an agent is working while AI is off. ## PR 306

**Multi-provider adapter: Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, OpenRouter, all dynamic**

**বাংলায়:** AI 360-এর লেখায় এখন চারটা সত্যিকার সেবা জুড়লো — Anthropic, OpenAI, Google আর OpenRouter — চাবি ও সংযোগ পাতায় একটা করে সারি। চাবি ও model না দেওয়া এবং test পাস না করা পর্যন্ত আগের মতোই অনুশীলনের লেখা হয়; একসাথে কয়েকটা চালু রাখা যায়, ফ্রি model লাইভে ব্যবহার হয় না।

**Details**

- **Status:** Merged · 2026-11-11
  - Build status row: Multi-provider adapter: Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, OpenRouter, all dynamic (C1.5; no migration — `AiProvider`/`AiModel` and `AI_PROVIDER` already in the full S00 schema; `packages/adapters/src/ai-writer/`): the AI writer's practice-only adapter (PR 221/293/243) gets its first four live providers — one key + one model id each (the owner types the model id his key may use; no model name trusted as current, per the blueprint), each a row in Keys & connections (`exclusive: false`, several may be on at once, like the payment gateways). Every provider answers the exact same `AiWriter` contract through one shared prompt-and-parse layer (`prompts.ts`, `live.ts`) — "write only from the facts given, reply as one JSON object" — so a draft from Claude, GPT, Gemini or an OpenRouter model is read the same way; a model that answers with anything else is a clean `AdapterError`, never a guess. OpenAI and OpenRouter share one Chat-Completions-shaped completer (`openai-compatible.ts`); OpenRouter's two attribution headers are optional. Falls back to the practice writer until a connection's key and model are in and its Test (one real sample SEO draft) passes. Free / OpenRouter-style models stay a hard no in production until PR 580's qualification; per-agent/per-job model choice is PR 307. Keys & connections guide updated with the four new rows.
  - GitHub pull request #113, 11 Nov
- **What it does (original scope):** Multi-provider adapter: Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, OpenRouter, all dynamic
- **Filed under:** [S15 · AI 360 Control Room — PR 304–341](../MASTER-REGISTER.md#s15--ai-360-control-room--pr-304341)
- **What was built** (from the Build status row):
  - Code and files: `packages/adapters/src/ai-writer/`, `prompts.ts`, `live.ts`, `openai-compatible.ts`
  - Names in the code: `AiProvider`, `AiModel`, `AI_PROVIDER`, `exclusive: false`, `AiWriter`, `AdapterError`
  - Tests: Falls back to the practice writer until a connection's key and model are in and its Test (one real sample SEO draft) passes
- **Owning agent:** Gyani
- **Mentions:** [PR 221](S11.md#pr-221), [PR 293](S14.md#pr-293), [PR 243](S12.md#pr-243), [PR 580](#pr-580), [PR 307](#pr-307)

## PR 307

**Per-agent model selection, with the recommendation note beside each**

**বাংলায়:** AI ৩৬০-এ প্রতিটা এজেন্টের নিজের মডেল বাছাইয়ের ড্রপডাউন হলো — প্র্যাকটিস রাইটার বা টেস্ট-পাস-করা একটা সরবরাহকারী। ক্লডের নিজের পছন্দ সুপারিশ করা থাকে একটা পিল দিয়ে, আর বাছাই বদলালে নিচে সৎ একটা নোট দেখায় — এখনই সংখ্যা বানিয়ে বলা হয় না।

**Details**

- **Status:** Merged · 2026-11-11
  - Build status row: Per-agent model selection, with the recommendation note beside each (C1.5; migration `0187_agent_selected_provider`, additive — `AiAgent.selectedProvider`, `null` = the practice writer; permission `ai.control`): each agent card in AI › Control room gets its own model picker (`ModelPickSelect`, the practice writer plus the four PR 306 connections; `POST /api/admin/ai {key, provider}`, audited `ai.agent.model`, idempotent). A connection that is not yet keyed and Tested is listed but disabled, so the owner can never point an agent at one that would only fall back anyway (`PROVIDER_NOT_READY`). Claude's own pick is recommended by default — the first ready provider, Anthropic first — shown with a "Recommended" pill; the note beside the select always explains the effect honestly: it matches the recommendation, or says plainly that per-run cost/quality comparisons wait for the AI Cost Book (PR 312) rather than inventing a number not yet measured. An agent's stored pick whose connection later goes dark or un-Tested quietly falls back to the practice writer, with its own note, never a silent error — no AiModel catalogue row is read or written yet (that is PR 312/580's job). ## PR 308

## PR 309

**Per-agent monthly spend cap**

**বাংলায়:** AI ৩৬০-এ প্রতিটা এজেন্টের নিজের মাসিক খরচের সীমা হলো — খালি রাখলে সীমা নেই। সীমার ৮০% ছুঁলে মালিকের Telegram-এ বাংলায় সতর্কতা যায় (সত্যিকারের পাঠানো, আন্দাজ নয়), ১০০%-এ নতুন কাজ থামার কথা পিলে দেখা যায়।

**Details**

- **Status:** Merged · 2026-11-11
  - Build status row: Per-agent monthly spend cap, with the 80% warning and the 100% pause (C1.6; no migration — `AiAgent.monthlyCapMinor` already in the full S00 schema, additive, unused until now; permission `ai.control`): each agent card in AI › Control room gets its own monthly spend cap (`CapInput`, new `apps/web/src/lib/admin-ai/spend-cap.ts`) — a plain amount in the store's own currency, major units, empty is "no cap" (off, the default). `POST /api/admin/ai {key, monthlyCapMinor}` validates the value (422 `INVALID_CAP` for anything but `null` or a whole number 1..2,147,483,647), audits `ai.agent.cap`, idempotent. `agentCapState` (none/ok/warned/paused, whole-number cross-multiplication so the 80% line is exact, never a float) and `wouldExceedCap` are built as pure, tested enforcement primitives ready for the job dispatcher to call before paying for one more run — no such dispatcher exists yet, since nothing in the codebase writes an `AiUsageLedger` row outside a test fixture (PR 306/307/308 are equally honest about this). What is real and live, not speculative: `checkAgentCapAlerts`, run on every read of the Control room, which sends the owner's Telegram warning the moment any agent's spend crosses 80%/100% of its own cap — deduplicated through the audit log (`ai.agent.capWarn80`/`ai.agent.capPaused`, once per crossing per month), never throwing (a Telegram hiccup never breaks the screen). The owner reads only চলতি বাংলা (CLAUDE.md), so the alert text is always Bengali, independent of whichever language an English-reading staff member has the admin UI itself set to; at 100% new generations would pause (already-approved output stays live, the shop unaffected) — the worked example the Blueprint gives for the Photoshoot agent, now true "as with any agent", the same widening PR 305 did for keep-on. Admin guide updated.
  - GitHub pull request #125, 11 Nov
- **What it does (original scope):** **Per-agent monthly spend cap**, with the 80% warning and the 100% pause

Built in 698 (wave 5). Nothing is deleted; the old screen stays reachable.

## PR 310

**Data-class routing — which class of data may reach which class of model**

**বাংলায়:** কোন তথ্য কোন AI মডেল পর্যন্ত যাবে তার নির্দিষ্ট নিয়ম হলো: ব্যক্তিগত বা ব্যবসার তথ্য কখনো ফ্রি-সক্ষম সংযোগে যায় না, এজেন্ট তা বাছলেও পাতা নিজে থেকেই টাকা-দেওয়া সংযোগ ব্যবহার করে আর কারণ লেখে; প্রকাশ্য/খসড়া লেখায় ফ্রি-সক্ষম সংযোগ চলে।

**Details**

- **Status:** Merged · 2026-11-11
  - Build status row: Data-class routing (A5.2, A5.6; no migration — purely a structural policy in code, like the agent catalogue; no owner setting): new `apps/web/src/lib/admin-ai/data-classes.ts` — the three Blueprint A5.2 data classes (personal, business, public/draft) and each of the seven fixed agents' own class (Gyani/Bhandari/Sawdagor personal, Prohori/Tirondaj business, Shilpi/Doot public/draft), plus `routeProvider`, which applies the Locked policy on top of PR 307's own model pick: personal and business work never effectively reaches OpenRouter (the one connection that can carry a free-tier model) even when the owner picks it and it is Tested-ready — the screen quietly uses the cheapest ready paid connection instead (or honestly the practice writer when none is ready) and explains why; public/draft work may use it as picked. `controlRoomView` now also returns each agent's `dataClass`/`effectiveProvider`/`routingDowngraded`. AI › Control room gains a data-class pill on every agent's model row and a new "Which data may reach which model" policy card stating the Locked rule itself, read-only. Per-job data-class tagging (one job can outrank its agent's own default) arrives with the AI Cost Book's 60–90 job rows (PR 312); until then the agent-level class can only ever be as careful as, or more careful than, that finer one. Admin guide updated.
- **What it does (original scope):** **Data-class routing** — which class of data may reach which class of model
- **Filed under:** [S15 · AI 360 Control Room — PR 304–341](../MASTER-REGISTER.md#s15--ai-360-control-room--pr-304341)
- **What was built** (from the Build status row):

## PR 311

**Details**

- **Status:** Merged · 2026-11-11
  - Build status row: The masking layer applied before anything leaves the server (A5.1–A5.4, FAQ 55; no migration, no owner setting, no admin page — a transport-level safety net, not a screen): new `packages/adapters/src/ai-writer/masking.ts` — `maskPersonalData` is a pattern-based safety net that strips every e-mail address and Bangladeshi-shaped phone number (however punctuated or prefixed: bare, `+880`, `880`, or the full `00880` international dial) out of a piece of text, replacing each with a plain `[EMAIL]`/`[PHONE]` token; `maskKnownIdentity` is exact-value stripping for a future job that already holds a real customer record (name/phone/e-mail/address), case-insensitive, three-character minimum so a stray initial is left alone. `liveAiWriter` (live.ts) now wraps every provider's `Completer` so `system`/`user` are masked right before the one call in the package that actually leaves the server over HTTP — a safety net layered on top of whatever provider-routing policy the data carries, never a replacement for one. Today's three draft kinds (SEO, campaign, article) carry no real customer content, so this is built ahead of the S14/S22 jobs that will send one (support replies, rider notes) — the same honestly-inert-until-wired shape earlier S15 PRs shipped before any AI key existed; `maskKnownIdentity` is exported and fully tested but not yet called by any job. No admin page changes.

## PR 312

**AI Cost Book — 60–90 job rows, searchable, with the model selector in the row**

**বাংলায়:** AI কস্ট বুক এলো — দোকানের ৬৫টা AI কাজের একটা খুঁজে-দেখার তালিকা, প্রতিটায় সুপারিশ করা মডেল ও কারণ, আনুমানিক খরচ, আর সরাসরি মডেল বদলানোর বাছাই। এখনো কোনো কাজ সত্যিকার চলেনি, তাই খরচ সৎভাবে শুধু আনুমানিক।

**Details**

- **Status:** Merged · 2026-11-11
  - Build status row: AI Cost Book — 60–90 job rows, searchable, with the model selector in the row (S15 reopened, CN-039; Blueprint C2.1, C2.2; no migration — `AiProvider`/`AiModel`/`AiJobType` already in the full S00 schema, additive, unused until now; permissions `ai.read`, `ai.control`): AI › Cost Book (`/admin/ai/cost-book`, Lumen), a new tab beside Control room and Checklist audit. A reference price catalogue (new `apps/web/src/lib/admin-ai/cost-book.ts`) of 16 models across Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, OpenRouter, FASHN, Stability, Runway, Pika and a server-render vendor, seeded into `AiProvider`/`AiModel` on first read (idempotent, `ensureCostBookSeeded`, the same upsert pattern as `ensureAgentRows`); 65 job types across the Blueprint's own eight sections (Support, Orders, Marketing, Social, SEO & blog, Site audit, Reports, Admin helpers) plus a ninth, Studio, with a row for every photoshoot/video sub-job the Blueprint names (ghost mannequin, try-on, detail re-projection, upscale, finishing, detail finder, quality scoring, image-to-video, reel assembly), seeded into `AiJobType`. Each row shows what the job does, Claude's own recommended model and why (small/cheap for classification and parsing, mid for writing, large only where real reasoning is needed), an estimated cost per run and per month (a believable `typicalRunsPerDay` baseline, never real usage — no job runner reads this yet), every other same-kind model's own cost (Alternatives), and a model selector that writes immediately (`POST /api/admin/ai/cost-book {jobKey, modelKey}`, `ai.control`, audited `ai.costBook.model`, idempotent, refused 422 for an unknown model or one of the wrong kind). Cost is priced in USD (how every AI vendor bills) and shown in the store's own currency through the owner's own USD rate (`ExchangeRate`/`pricerFor`, PR 345/266) once he has typed one; until then every figure is shown honestly in USD, with a plain note why, never an invented taka amount. A searchable table (`CostBookSearch`, client-side, no round trip) and a "10 priciest jobs" section (C2.3). Honest notes printed on the page itself (C2.4): text is cheap, image generation is far more expensive, video assembly costs server time rather than tokens, and every estimate carries a ±10–15% band until real usage arrives. Out of scope, each its own PR: estimate-vs-actual self-correction (313), the what-if slider and Economy/Balanced/Premium presets (314), the free-form cost calculator reachable from Telegram (316) — the shared usage ledger (315) was already built by PR 309. ## PR 313

**Estimate versus actual, and the self-correction that follows**

**বাংলায়:** কস্ট বুকে এখন অনুমানের পাশে 'ঠিক খরচ' কলাম — কোনো কাজের অন্তত ৫টা সত্যিকার রান গত ৩০ দিনে হয়ে থাকলে আসল গড় খরচ আর অনুমানের চেয়ে কত বেশি/কম তা দেখায়। এখনো কোনো কাজ সত্যিকার চলেনি, তাই সব কাজেই এই কলাম খালি — সত্যিকার তথ্য এলে নিজে নিজে ভরে উঠবে।

**Details**

- **Status:** Merged · 2026-11-11
  - Build status row: Estimate versus actual, and the self-correction that follows (S15 reopened, CN-039; Blueprint C2.3; no migration — `AiJobType.actualPerRunMicros` already in the full S00 schema, additive, tagged for this PR, unused until now): a second, independent "Actual (last 30 days)" figure beside every job's estimate in the Cost Book, read from `AiUsageLedger.jobTypeKey` (PR 315's own ledger; still no job dispatcher writes a real row, honestly null exactly as `spend-cap.ts` already says of the same table) and persisted into `AiJobType.actualPerRunMicros` so a report elsewhere can read it without recomputing. `cost-book.ts` gains `actualOf` (the average real cost per run and its % deviation from the estimate) and `actualAggregatesSince` (one `AiUsageLedger.groupBy` for the whole book, not one query per job); shown only once `MIN_ACTUAL_SAMPLES` (5) real runs exist within `ACTUAL_WINDOW_DAYS` (30, the same length as the book's own monthly estimate), so one stray run never reads as "the real cost" — this never overwrites the estimate or the owner's own model pick; the owner reads both and decides. New column in `/admin/ai/cost-book`'s table and its own strings (`admin-ai.{bn,en}.json`); the honest C2.4 note updated to explain the band narrows once real data exists. 4 new pure tests (`actualOf`'s own math) + 1 new DB test (null with no usage, ignores a too-old run, fills in and persists once the threshold is reached, stays null for an untouched job) — 86/86 admin-ai tests green. Admin guide `docs/admin-guide/pages/ai/cost-book.md` updated in the same commit.

## PR 315

**One shared usage ledger behind every figure**

**বাংলায়:** AI-র প্রতিটা খরচের পেছনে এখন একটাই ভাগাভাগি করা হিসাবের খাতা লেখার পথ তৈরি — যেকোনো আসল AI কাজ একবার চললে তার খরচ ঠিক একইভাবে গণনা হয়ে এক জায়গায় লেখা হবে, যাতে এজেন্টের মাসিক সীমা আর কস্ট বুকের 'ঠিক খরচ' কলাম কখনো দুই রকম হিসাব না দেখায়। USD রেট বসানো না থাকলে টাকার অঙ্ক বানিয়ে লেখা হয় না — সত্যিকার কাজ চালানোর কোনো যন্ত্র এখনো নেই, তাই এটাও এখনো ব্যবহার হচ্ছে না।

**Details**

- **Status:** Merged · 2026-11-11
  - Build status row: One shared usage ledger behind every figure (S15 reopened, CN-039; Blueprint C1.6/C2.6; no migration — `AiUsageLedger` already in the full S00 schema, tagged for this PR, written for the first time here): new `apps/web/src/lib/admin-ai/usage-ledger.ts` — `recordAiUsage`, the single shared write path every future AI job dispatcher is meant to call for a real run's cost, so the two figures that already read this table (PR 309's `agentCapState`/`checkAgentCapAlerts` by `agentId`+`costMinor`, PR 313's `actualOf` by `jobTypeKey`+`costUsdMicros`) are always fed from one computation instead of each future writer risking its own currency drifting apart from the Cost Book's own estimate. Reuses `cost-book.ts`'s own cost model (`estimateMicrosFor`/`modelOf`/`microsToUsdMinor`) rather than a second pricing table. As honest as every other AI 360 module about the one thing still true: no job dispatcher exists yet, so nothing in the real codebase calls this in production. `costMinor` (the store's own currency) is never invented when no USD rate has been typed (CLAUDE.md rule 1, CN-016): `recordAiUsage` honestly refuses with `{ok: false, error: 'NO_EXCHANGE_RATE'}` rather than guessing one — a real job dispatcher is expected to hold the usage and retry once a rate exists, never to write a guessed figure into a column PR 304/309 already trust. Idempotent on the schema's own unique `idempotencyKey` column: a retry (timeout, re-delivered job message) returns the first call's own result with `idempotent: true`, including the rare race where two concurrent callers share a key (caught via the unique-constraint violation, `P2002`, not a read-then-write check, which cannot by itself prevent the race). Throws only for a genuine caller bug (`UNKNOWN_MODEL`, `WRONG_KIND` — a model's kind not matching the usage shape given, `UNKNOWN_AGENT`). No admin page: this is the write-side library behind figures already shown by PR 304/312/313's own pages, not a new screen, so no new admin guide is needed. 5 new DB tests (`usage-ledger.db.test.ts`: refuses with no USD rate and writes nothing; throws for each caller-bug case and writes nothing; once a rate exists, computes the exact same micros the Cost Book's own math would, resolves the agent id, and a retry is idempotent; a job with no agent attached writes a null `agentId`, never a guessed one; the written rows are summed correctly by both PR 309's and PR 313's own query shapes) — 112/112 admin-ai tests green (was 107/107 after PR 314). Gates: hardcode guard 0 findings, admin-guide-check clean, lint/typecheck clean. Fourth commit on `pr-312-ai-cost-book`/#137 (not a fresh branch): reuses `cost-book.ts`'s still-unmerged exports directly rather than duplicating the cost model. **Note for the rebase-merge:** this branch's base predates PR 310/311 landing on `main` (PR 310 merged there as a separate, independent PR while this branch was in progress); the PR-count/progress figures in this commit are this branch's own running total (continuing 304–309, 312–315) and will need reconciling with `main`'s own count (which already includes 310) when the coordinator rebase-merges — the code itself has no dependency on 310/311 and conflicts only in the shared narrative files (`MASTER-REGISTER.md`, `PROGRESS.md`, `README.md`, `docs/stages/`).
  - GitHub pull request #137, 11–12 Nov

## PR 316

**Free-form cost calculator**

**বাংলায়:** AI কস্ট বুকে এখন একটা মুক্ত-হাতের ক্যালকুলেটর যোগ হলো — নিজের কথায় একটা কাজ বেছে, কতবার চালাবেন তা লিখে, খরচ আগেই দেখে নেওয়া যায়; একসাথে কয়েকটা কাজ মিলিয়ে একটা পুরো পরিকল্পনার মোট খরচও বের করা যায়, আর পছন্দ হলে নাম দিয়ে পরে দেখার জন্য সেভ করে রাখা যায়। টেলিগ্রাম থেকে একই জিনিস জিজ্ঞাসা করার সুবিধা এখনো আসেনি, সেটা পরের একটা কাজ।

**Details**

- **Status:** Merged · 2026-11-11
  - Build status row: Free-form cost calculator (S15 reopened, CN-039; Blueprint C2.5; no migration — `AiCostPlan` already in the full S00 schema, tagged for this PR, written for the first time here; permission `ai.control`): beside the Cost Book's own job table, a calculator (new `apps/web/src/lib/admin-ai/calculator.ts`, `calculator-api.ts`, `POST /api/admin/ai/cost-book/calculator`, new `CostBookCalculator.tsx`) where the owner describes a piece of work as one or more lines — an existing Cost Book job, how many runs, and optionally how much bigger/smaller than the job's own usual run (e.g. a longer article) — and gets a cost before committing, up to 5 lines at once; a composite question ("10 blog posts with 3 images each") becomes two priced lines totalled together. Reuses the Cost Book's own cost model (`jobOf`/`modelOf`/`estimateMicrosFor`/`alternativesFor`/`microsToUsdMinor`, PR 312) rather than a second one, so the calculator's number for a job can never disagree with that job's own row in the book; `calculateLine`/`calculatePlan` are pure (no DB) and reusable by any future caller, with the DB-aware `planView`/`savePlan` the only functions touching Prisma. A single-line plan not already on the job's own recommended model, where that recommendation is genuinely cheaper, gets a one-line savings note; a composite plan stays silent rather than guessing which line to flag. "Save as plan" (`ai.control`) persists the estimate onto `AiCostPlan` (a single-job plan remembers its `jobTypeKey`, a composite one leaves it null), audited `ai.calculator.plan`, so a later PR can compare it against a real run's cost once a job dispatcher exists (`actualMicros` stays null until then, the same honest gap PR 306/307/308/309/312/313/315 already note). Out of scope, its own later PR: Blueprint C2.5's "reachable from Telegram" — no inbound Telegram command handling exists anywhere in this codebase yet (the Telegram adapter, PR 392, is outbound-only), and that webhook/intent layer is shared, reusable infrastructure PR 317's approval queue will also need, not something to grow inside this PR; `AiCostPlan.createdVia` is already shaped for it (`'admin'` here, `'telegram'` later) so no column needs to change when it arrives. Admin guide `docs/admin-guide/pages/ai/cost-book.md` updated in the same commit with the new Calculator section. 12 new pure tests (`calculator.test.ts`: exact cost math for a text and an image job, alternatives, scale, model override, the null-store honesty when no exchange rate exists, every error case, the single-line recommendation note, composite totals) + 7 new DB tests (`calculator-api.db.test.ts`: only `ai.control` may price or save a plan; a single-line and a composite plan price correctly and write nothing on preview; each caller-input error is refused; "Save as plan" writes exactly one `AiCostPlan` row and one audit entry with the exact estimate; a composite plan's saved row carries no single `jobTypeKey`; saving without a description is refused and saves nothing) — 126/126 admin-ai tests green (was 112/112 after PR 315). Gates: hardcode guard 0 findings, admin-guide-check clean, lint/typecheck clean. Fifth commit on `pr-312-ai-cost-book`/#137 (not a fresh branch): directly extends `cost-book.ts`/`page.tsx`, still-unmerged PR 312 files, same stacking as 313/314/315. Carries forward PR 315's own note: this branch's base still predates PR 310/311 landing on `main`, for the rebase-merge coordinator to reconcile.
  - GitHub pull request #137, 11–12 Nov
- **What it does (original scope):** **Free-form cost calculator**, reachable from Telegram
- **Filed under:** [S15 · AI 360 Control Room — PR 304–341](../MASTER-REGISTER.md#s15--ai-360-control-room--pr-304341)
- **What was built** (from the Build status row):
  - Code and files: `apps/web/src/lib/admin-ai/calculator.ts`, `calculator-api.ts`, `POST /api/admin/ai/cost-book/calculator`, `CostBookCalculator.tsx`, `docs/admin-guide/pages/ai/cost-book.md`, `calculator.test.ts`, `calculator-api.db.test.ts`, `cost-book.ts`, `page.tsx`
  - Settings and named keys: `ai.control`, `ai.calculator.plan`
  - Names in the code: `AiCostPlan`, `jobOf`, `modelOf`, `estimateMicrosFor`, `alternativesFor`, `microsToUsdMinor`, `calculateLine`, `calculatePlan`, `planView`, `savePlan`, `jobTypeKey`, `actualMicros`, `AiCostPlan.createdVia`, `'admin'`, `'telegram'`, `pr-312-ai-cost-book`, `main`
  - Tests: 12 new pure tests (`calculator.test.ts`: exact cost math for a text and an image job, alternatives, scale, model override, the null-store honesty when no exchange rate exists, every error case, the single-line recommendation note, composite totals) + 7 new DB tests (`calculator-api.db.test.ts`: only `ai.control` may price or save a plan
  - Tests: saving without a description is refused and saves nothing) — 126/126 admin-ai tests green (was 112/112 after PR 315)

## PR 317

**The single approval queue — everything waiting on the owner, in one place**

**বাংলায়:** এখন থেকে কোনো AI এজেন্ট একা করতে পারে না এমন সব কাজ — টাকা, রিফান্ড, COD বদল, দাম, ছাড়, বিজ্ঞাপনের বাজেট, ব্লক করা বা মুছে ফেলা — একটাই অপেক্ষার তালিকায় এসে জমা হবে (AI › অনুমোদন), পুরনো থেকে নতুন ক্রমে, যাতে মালিক এক বসায় সব ক্লিয়ার করতে পারেন। সাইট স্বাস্থ্যের সমাধান আর নতুন স্কিলের অনুমোদন আগে থেকেই যেখানে হতো, সেটাই থাকছে — এই তালিকায় শুধু সেগুলো একসাথে দেখা যাবে, সিদ্ধান্ত নেওয়ার জায়গা বদলাচ্ছে না।

**Details**

- **Status:** Merged · 2026-11-11
  - Build status row: The single approval queue — everything waiting on the owner, in one place (S15 reopened, CN-039; Blueprint C3.2; no migration — `AiApprovalRequest` already in the full S00 schema, tagged for this PR, written for the first time here; permission `ai.control` to decide, `ai.read` to see): AI › Approvals (`/admin/ai/approvals`, Lumen, new tab beside Control room/Cost Book) — everything an AI 360 agent wants to do but may not do alone (money movement, refund, COD change, price change, discount, ad-budget increase, blocking, deletion), in one queue, oldest first, so the owner clears it "in one pass". New `apps/web/src/lib/admin-ai/approvals.ts`: `requestApproval` (creates a pending request, deduped by `refType`+`refId` so a retried job or a double "ask the owner" call never queues the same thing twice), `expireStaleApprovals` (flips a stale `PENDING` row to `EXPIRED` on every read, the same "fresh on every read" pattern as the spend-cap alerts), `approvalsView` (every kind together, plus a short decided/expired/cancelled history, each decider's own name resolved once per view) and `decideApproval` (approve/reject with an optional note; a repeat tap with the *same* decision is a no-op, the *other* decision or anything already decided is refused with its real status, never silently overwritten). `KNOWN_KINDS`/`kindLabelOf` give a Bengali/English label for the Blueprint's own named categories while honestly falling back to the raw `kind` string for anything not yet named — `kind` stays a plain column, not a closed enum, so a future agent kind this PR did not foresee still works. **This table already has a real producer and decider — S21 · PR 420's `admin-health/fixes.ts` (Reports › Site health › Fixes to approve), which writes and decides `health.fix`/`ai.skill` requests with its own permission (`health.fixes.approve`) and its own side effects (a `SiteAuditFinding`/`AiSkill` row moves with the decision).** This PR is a thin, unifying *read* layer on top of the same table, never a second way to decide a fix or a skill: `approvalsView` lists every kind together so the owner genuinely sees everything in one place, but `decideApproval`/`requestApproval` both refuse a `GATE_KINDS` row outright (`USE_FIX_GATE`), and `POST /api/admin/ai/approvals` (`approvals-api.ts`) routes a `health.fix`/`ai.skill` row straight to `fixes.decideProposal` instead — same for `expireStaleApprovals`, called alongside `fixes.expireProposals` rather than touching its rows. The admin page (`page.tsx`, new `ApprovalDecideButtons.tsx`) shows every pending row with its kind, requesting agent, title and summary, gated per-row by whichever permission that row's kind actually needs (`ai.control` for this file's own kinds, `health.fixes.approve` for the two PR 420 owns), and a short decision history (status pill, who decided it and when, the note). A decision here is permanent, no Undo, matching CLAUDE.md's "never without the owner's written OK" for money/refunds/COD/prices/discounts/blocking/deletion — the tap itself *is* that written OK. Admin guide `docs/admin-guide/pages/ai/approvals.md`. 3 new pure tests (`kindLabelOf`/`KNOWN_KINDS`) + 12 new DB tests (`approvals-api.db.test.ts`: only `ai.read` opens the queue; only `ai.control` decides this file's own kinds; a double tap with the same decision is a no-op, the other decision is refused; a stale request expires on read; a `health.fix`/`ai.skill` row cannot be created or decided through this file directly — only `fixes.ts`'s own `proposeFix`/`proposeSkill`/`decideProposal` may; such a row still lists in the same unified queue; a controller with only `ai.control` cannot decide it, a fix approver with only `health.fixes.approve` can, through this same unified API) — 15/15 approvals tests green, 199/199 admin-ai + admin-health tests green overall (confirms PR 420's own suite is unaffected by this read-only, import-only integration). Gates: hardcode guard 0 findings, admin-guide-check clean, lint/typecheck clean. Sixth commit on `pr-312-ai-cost-book`/#137 (not a fresh branch): new files only, no edit to any still-unmerged PR 312–316 file. Carries forward PR 315/316's own note: this branch's base still predates PR 310/311 landing on `main`, for the rebase-merge coordinator to reconcile.
  - GitHub pull request #137, 11–12 Nov
- **What it does (original scope):** The single approval queue — everything waiting on the owner, in one place
- **Filed under:** [S15 · AI 360 Control Room — PR 304–341](../MASTER-REGISTER.md#s15--ai-360-control-room--pr-304341)
- **What was built** (from the Build status row):
  - Code and files: `apps/web/src/lib/admin-ai/approvals.ts`, `admin-health/fixes.ts`, `POST /api/admin/ai/approvals`, `approvals-api.ts`, `page.tsx`, `ApprovalDecideButtons.tsx`, `docs/admin-guide/pages/ai/approvals.md`, `approvals-api.db.test.ts`, `fixes.ts`
  - Routes: `/admin/ai/approvals`
  - Settings and named keys: `ai.control`, `ai.read`, `health.fix`, `ai.skill`, `health.fixes.approve`, `fixes.decideProposal`, `fixes.expireProposals`
  - Names in the code: `AiApprovalRequest`, `requestApproval`, `refType`, `refId`, `expireStaleApprovals`, `PENDING`, `EXPIRED`, `approvalsView`, `decideApproval`, `KNOWN_KINDS`, `kindLabelOf`, `kind`, `SiteAuditFinding`, `AiSkill`, `GATE_KINDS`, `USE_FIX_GATE`, `proposeFix`, `proposeSkill`, `decideProposal`, `pr-312-ai-cost-book`, `main`
  - Tests: 3 new pure tests (`kindLabelOf`/`KNOWN_KINDS`) + 12 new DB tests (`approvals-api.db.test.ts`: only `ai.read` opens the queue
  - Tests: a controller with only `ai.control` cannot decide it, a fix approver with only `health.fixes.approve` can, through this same unified API) — 15/15 approvals tests green, 199/199 admin-ai + admin-health tests green overall (confirms PR 420's own suite is unaffected by this read-only, import-only integration)
- **Owning agent:** Gyani

## PR 318

**Permission matrix: what each agent may decide alone**

**বাংলায়:** প্রতিটা AI এজেন্টের নিজের কার্ডে এখন সাতটা বিষয় (অর্ডার, স্টক, দাম, কুরিয়ার, টাকা, কাস্টমারের তথ্য, কোড) দেখা যাবে, প্রতিটায় একা সিদ্ধান্ত নিতে পারবে, প্রথমে জিজ্ঞাসা করতে হবে, বা হাতই দিতে পারবে না — এই তিনটার একটা বাছাই করা থাকে (AI › পারমিশন)। যে ঘর মালিক এখনো বদলাননি সেটা সবচেয়ে নিরাপদ অবস্থায়, 'প্রথমে জিজ্ঞাসা করতে হবে' — মালিক না বাড়ালে কোনো এজেন্ট কখনো একা কিছু করতে পারবে না।

**Details**

- **Status:** Merged · 2026-11-11
  - Build status row: Permission matrix: what each agent may decide alone (S15 reopened, CN-039; Blueprint C3.2; no migration — `AgentPermission` already in the full S00 schema, tagged for this PR, written for the first time here; permission `ai.control` to change a cell, `ai.read` to see): AI › Permissions (`/admin/ai/permissions`, Lumen, new tab beside Approvals) — one card per fixed agent, over the Blueprint's own seven resources (orders, stock, prices, courier, money, customer data, code), each with a level the owner sets: **alone** (the agent decides and acts, no approval needed), **propose** (the agent may only ask — lands in PR 317's single approval queue) or **none** (the agent may not touch this resource at all, not even to propose). Every cell nobody has ever set reads as `propose`, never `alone` — the safe, off-by-default starting point CLAUDE.md rule 1/CN-018 require for every owner-set switch, shown on the page with its own "Default" badge so the owner can tell "never touched" apart from "chosen to match the default". New `apps/web/src/lib/admin-ai/permissions.ts`: `RESOURCES` (the closed seven-key catalogue, English/Bengali labels, never falling back to a raw string the way `approvals.ts`'s `KNOWN_KINDS` does — a resource is a structural fact decided when a new kind of AI action is built, not an owner's or agent's input), `LEVELS`/`DEFAULT_LEVEL`, `permissionsView` (every fixed agent × every resource, default-filled), `setAgentPermission` (one cell, a no-op on a repeat of the same value, audited `ai.permission.set` otherwise) and the enforcement primitives `agentPermissionLevel`/`agentMayActAlone`/`agentMayProposeOrAct` — pure/tested and ready for the first real agent action (PR 583's chief-agent routing, S24's Photoshoot agent's own "media only, never price/stock/orders/customer data" rule) the same honest gap PR 304–317 already note: nothing in this codebase executes a real agent action yet, so nothing calls them in production. New `permissions-api.ts` (`GET`/`POST /api/admin/ai/permissions`; GET needs only `ai.read`; POST needs `ai.control`) and its route. New admin page (`page.tsx`, new `PermissionLevelSelect.tsx`, new `permissions.css`): one card per agent, a `<select>` per resource for anyone with `ai.control` (plain text otherwise), the same Undo-offering toast every other admin-ai switch here uses. Admin shell: a new `permissions` tab beside `approvals` in the `ai` section (`sections.ts`, `help-pages.json`, plus the `shell.tab.ai.permissions` label this PR adds — `approvals`' own tab label was found missing from the same block while adding this one, left for the rebase-merge coordinator rather than touched here, out of this PR's own scope), new strings `admin-ai.{bn,en}.json`'s `aiPermissions.*`, new Bengali page guide `docs/admin-guide/pages/ai/permissions.md` (linked from `ai/index.md`). 8 new pure tests (`permissions.test.ts`: the resource catalogue's shape, `isResourceKey`/`resourceLabel`, `LEVELS`/`isPermissionLevel`, `DEFAULT_LEVEL` is `propose` not `alone`, `agentMayActAlone`/`agentMayProposeOrAct`) + 6 new DB tests (`permissions-api.db.test.ts`: all seven agents start at `propose`/default on every cell; only `ai.read` opens the matrix, only `ai.control` changes a cell; widening one cell to `alone` is audited and leaves every other cell untouched; narrowing a different cell to `none`, and a repeat of the same value is a no-op with no new audit row; an unknown agent/resource/level is refused; `agentPermissionLevel` reads the safe default for an untouched cell) — 14/14 permissions tests green, 155/155 admin-ai tests green overall (was 141/141 before this PR). Gates: hardcode guard 0 findings, admin-guide-check clean, lint/typecheck clean (`NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=8192`, the shared runner's default heap otherwise OOMs on this repo's `tsc --noEmit`). Seventh commit on `pr-312-ai-cost-book`/#137, from a **separate fresh worktree** (`.claude/worktrees/ai1-s15-pr318`, off `origin/pr-312-ai-cost-book`'s own tip) rather than the lane's usual worktree, which a concurrent FIX-lane session was resolving this same branch's main-merge conflict in at the time — new files only, no edit to any still-unmerged PR 312–317 file, so no collision either way. Carries forward PR 315/316/317's own note: this branch's base still predates PR 311 landing on `main` (PR 310 landed separately while PR 317 was in progress); the PR-count/progress figures in this commit are this branch's own running total, for the rebase-merge coordinator to reconcile against `main`'s own count at merge time.
  - GitHub pull request #137, 11–12 Nov

## PR 319

**AI diary — what each agent did, why, and what it changed**

**বাংলায়:** AI-এর ডায়েরি এখন আছে (AI › ডায়েরি) — প্রতিটা এজেন্ট কী করেছে, কেন করেছে, আর কী বদলেছে তার এক লাইনের চলতি বাংলা লেখা, নতুনগুলো আগে, এজেন্ট আর দিনের সীমা দিয়ে ফিল্টার করা যায়। কোনো এজেন্ট এখনো সত্যিকার কাজ করতে পারে না বলে পাতাটা এখনো খালি — প্রথম কাজ শুরু হলে এখানেই লেখা উঠবে, ফটোশুট এজেন্টের দিনের কাজও এখানে আসবে পরে।

**Details**

- **Status:** Merged · 2026-11-12

## PR 320

**Bug box: the agent reports what it could not do**

**বাংলায়:** একই ডায়েরি পাতায় এখন বাগ বক্স যুক্ত হয়েছে — সব/যা করেছে/বাগ বক্স তিনটা ট্যাব, প্রতিটার পাশে সংখ্যা, একই এজেন্ট আর দিনের সীমা ফিল্টারে চলে। বাগ বক্সে থাকে কোনো এজেন্ট কোনো কাজ করতে পারেনি আর কেন পারেনি তার লেখা — ডেমোর স্ক্রিন অনুযায়ী শুধু এজেন্টের লেখা, মালিকের নিজের প্রশ্ন লেখার জায়গা এখনো তৈরি হয়নি। কোনো এজেন্ট এখনো সত্যিকার কাজ করতে পারে না বলে এটাও এখনো খালি।

**Details**

- **Status:** Merged · 2026-11-12
  - Build status row: Bug box: the agent reports what it could not do (S15 reopened, CN-039; Blueprint C1.7; no migration — `AiBugReport` already in the full S00 schema, tagged for this PR, written for the first time here; permission `ai.read`): the same AI › Diary page (`/admin/ai/diary`) gains a second segment and a 3-way tab nav (সব/যা করেছে/বাগ বক্স, each with its own count), filtered by the same agent + day-window controls as the diary half. **Scope decision, following CLAUDE.md's "the demo is the UI truth… match it":** the Blueprint's `AiBugReport` schema comment and C1.7's prose also describe a separate owner-facing "write a problem, AI investigates → explains → proposes → approves" flow, but the demo (`97y-adm2-ai.js`, screen AIC-09) shows only the read-only agent-reported "could not do" segment with no owner composer anywhere, and that investigate flow has no register PR number of its own and needs a real investigating agent that does not exist yet — so this PR builds only the agent-reported direction the demo actually shows, deferring the owner's own composer to a later, currently-unscoped PR (noted in the admin guide's "এরপর কী হয়"). New `apps/web/src/lib/admin-ai/bugbox.ts`: `reportCouldNotDo` (one agent-written report — a title plus a plain-Bengali "why", status always starts `open`; resolves the real agent row via `ensureAgentRows`; throws only for an unknown agent key or an empty title/why) and `bugBoxView`, sharing PR 319's own `DIARY_DEFAULT_DAYS`/`DIARY_MAX_ROWS` constants and window/agent-filter logic exactly, so the two segments of one page always agree on what "recent" means. ## PR 321

**Skill library — import a skill, version it, roll it back**

**বাংলায়:** AI › স্কিল পাতা এখন আছে — প্রতিটা স্কিলের নাম, এজেন্ট, ভার্সন আর অবস্থা এক তালিকায়, অনুমোদিত স্কিল চালু/বন্ধ করা যায় আর এক চাপে আগের ভার্সনে ফেরানো যায় (পুরনো ভার্সন কখনো মুছে যায় না)। মালিক নিজে বাইরে থেকে একটা নতুন স্কিল "আনতে" পারেন, যা একই অনুমোদনের তালিকায় যায় আর আগের জায়গাতেই সিদ্ধান্ত হয়। স্কিল চালানোর যন্ত্র এখনো নেই, তাই চালু করা স্কিলও এখনো সত্যিকার কাজ করে না।

**Details**

- **Status:** Merged · 2026-11-12
  - Build status row: Skill library — import a skill, version it, roll it back (S15 reopened, CN-039; Blueprint C1.7 "Skill library" + "Import a skill from outside", demo screen AIC-04 "Skills › Library"; no migration — `AiSkill`/`AiSkillVersion`/`AiSkillExport` already in the full S00 schema, tagged for this PR, written for the first time here; permission `ai.skills.write` to import/roll back/toggle, `ai.read` to see): AI › Skills (`/admin/ai/skills`, Lumen, new tab beside Permissions/Diary) — every `AiSkill` as a row (name, agent, version, status, updated-at) with, once approved, an on/off switch and a one-click "roll back" to the version before it, plus the owner's own "Import a skill" dialog. **Single-decision-path kept intact:** `fixes.ts`'s own `proposeSkill`/`decideProposal` (S21 · PR 420) is still the only producer/decider for an *agent-proposed* skill — this PR adds the owner's own direct entry point (`importSkill`, status always starts `proposed`, same vocabulary, same `AiApprovalRequest` row) so both paths land in the one queue PR 317 already reads and are decided in the one place `fixes.ts`'s own header comment already reserves ("the skill library, PR 321–323"); this file never decides a proposal itself. New `apps/web/src/lib/admin-ai/skills.ts`: `importSkill` (name + optional purpose, `AI_AGENTS`-checked agent key, a slugified unique `key` retried on collision, `AiSkillVersion` 1 written with placeholder content pending real authoring, an `AiApprovalRequest` created via the shared queue, audited `ai.skill.import`), `skillLibraryView` (every skill, newest-updated first, joined to its current/older approved version counts), `rollbackSkill` (moves `AiSkill.currentVersion` back one approved step — append-only, no row ever deleted, matching CLAUDE.md rule 3 — refuses with `NO_OLDER_VERSION` when none exists) and `setSkillEnabled` (only once `status==='approved'`, a no-op on a repeat of the same value, audited `ai.skill.enable`). As honest as every other S15 write path about the one thing that has not changed: no job dispatcher or skill-execution runtime exists yet, so an imported/enabled skill is not yet actually run by any agent — this PR builds the library's own management surface, not execution. New `skills-api.ts` (`GET`/`POST /api/admin/ai/skills`, `action` discriminator import/rollback/enable; GET needs `ai.read`, POST needs `ai.skills.write`) and its route. New admin page (`page.tsx`, new `SkillImportDialog.tsx`/`SkillRollbackButton.tsx`/`SkillEnableSwitch.tsx`, `ai.css` gains `.ai-sk-actions`): an `a2-tbl` table matching the demo's own column set, a status pill (proposed/rejected/expired/approved-on/approved-off), the import dialog gated behind `ai.skills.write`, and a read-only notice for anyone without it. New permission `ai.skills.write` (`catalogue.ts`, `auth.{en,bn}.json`), new admin-shell tab `skills` (`sections.ts`, `help-pages.json`, `admin-shell.{en,bn}.json`'s `tab.ai.skills`), new strings `admin-ai.{bn,en}.json`'s `aiSkills.*`, new Bengali page guide `docs/admin-guide/pages/ai/skills.md` (six parts, linked from `ai/index.md`). 7 new DB tests (`skills.db.test.ts`): `importSkill` writes a version-1 skill plus one approval request and refuses an unknown agent/empty name; `skillLibraryView` lists newest-updated first with correct version counts; `rollbackSkill` moves the pointer back and refuses when no older approved version exists; `setSkillEnabled` only works once approved, is a no-op on a repeat value, and is audited. Gates: hardcode guard 0 findings, admin-guide-check clean, lint clean, typecheck clean (`NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=8192`). Tenth commit on `pr-312-ai-cost-book`/#137 (not a fresh branch): new files only, no edit to any still-unmerged PR 312–320 file. Carries forward PR 319/320's own note: this branch's base still predates PR 311 landing on `main`; the PR-count/progress figures in this commit are this branch's own running total, for the rebase-merge coordinator to reconcile against `main`'s own count at merge time.

## PR 322

**Skill sandbox: try a skill on real data without touching production**

**বাংলায়:** AI › স্কিল-এ এখন একটা "পরীক্ষার জায়গা" (Sandbox) ট্যাব আছে — কোনো স্কিল অনুমোদনের আগেই গত ৭ বা ৩০ দিনের আসল অর্ডারের উপর "পরীক্ষা" চালানো যায়, শুধু-পড়ার, কিছু লেখা/পাঠানো/কাটা হয় না। কতগুলো আসল অর্ডার পড়া হলো আর (সম্ভব হলে) আনুমানিক খরচ দেখায়; স্কিল আসলে কোন অর্ডারে কী করত তা এখনো বলা যায় না, কারণ কাজ চালানোর যন্ত্র তৈরি হয়নি — সংখ্যা বানিয়ে দেখানো হয় না।

**Details**

- **Status:** Merged · 2026-11-12

## PR 323

**Continuous skill training — corrections become training examples**

**বাংলায়:** এখন থেকে AI › অনুমোদন পাতায় কোনো স্কিল "কারণ লিখে" বাতিল করলে, সেই কারণ আর স্কিলের লেখাটা ঐ এজেন্টের একটা "শেখার উদাহরণ" (training example) হয়ে ডেটাবেসে থেকে যায় — কারণ ছাড়া বাতিল করলে বা অনুমোদন করলে কিছু লেখা হয় না, আন্দাজ করে কিছু বানানো হয় না। এজেন্টের নিজের প্রোফাইল পাতায় (এখনো তৈরি হয়নি) এগুলো "ভুল থেকে শেখা" তালিকায় দেখানো হবে।

**Details**

- **Status:** Merged · 2026-11-12
  - Build status row: Continuous skill training — corrections become training examples (S15 reopened, CN-039; Blueprint C1.8 "every correction the owner makes becomes a training example"; C3.3 repeats the same standing requirement for every agent; the demo's own agent-profile screen `89b-admin-agents.js` shows the result as each agent's own "Lessons (owner corrections)" list; no migration — `AiTrainingExample` already in the full S00 schema, tagged for this PR, written for the first time here; permission `ai.read` to see): the real plumbing behind that standing requirement, triggered from the one genuine "correction" moment the codebase has today — the owner rejecting an `ai.skill` proposal **with a reason**, through the one approval queue (PR 317) `fixes.decideProposal` (S21 · PR 420) already decides every skill through. **Only edit to an existing file:** `approvals-api.ts`'s own POST handler now also calls the new `recordSkillCorrection` right after such a rejection — the rejected version's own content becomes `input`, the owner's own reason becomes `expected`, tagged with the skill's own agent; approving, or rejecting with no reason, writes nothing (an honest gap, never a guessed lesson). New `apps/web/src/lib/admin-ai/training.ts`: `recordSkillCorrection` (honest, not best-effort-fabricated — returns `null`, writing nothing, when there is no real version content or no real agent to credit) and `trainingExamplesView` (newest-first, never-archived examples, optionally narrowed by agent and/or skill; CLAUDE.md rule 3 — nothing here is ever deleted). **Honest about what has not changed:** the demo's own screen that would *read* this table — the agent-profile page's "Lessons (owner corrections)" list — is PR 577's own (C10.4), not yet built, and no training/fine-tuning pipeline consumes these rows yet either (the same gap PR 321/322 already note for the skill-execution engine). New `training-api.ts` + `GET /api/admin/ai/training` route (`ai.read`, optional `?agent=`/`?skill=`) — no dashboard page reads it yet (there is nowhere in the demo to put one before PR 577 exists), so this small read-only endpoint exists only so the data is already real and queryable the day that page is built. `docs/admin-guide/pages/ai/skills.md`'s own "এরপর কী হয়" extended (not rewritten) to say so. 8 new DB tests (`training.db.test.ts`, the writer called straight plus the full real loop through `importSkill`/`approvalsHandler`/`fixes.decideProposal`): `recordSkillCorrection` honestly writes nothing for an unknown skill, an unmatched version or a blank reason; rejecting a real skill proposal with a reason writes exactly one training example tagged with the skill's own agent and key, audited `ai.training.correction`; rejecting with no reason writes nothing; approving writes nothing; rejecting a `health.fix` row (not a skill) writes nothing — this is a skill-only mechanic; `trainingExamplesView` narrows by agent and is an honest empty list for an unrecognised one; `GET /api/admin/ai/training` needs `ai.read` and answers the same rows newest first. Gates: hardcode guard 0 findings (3224 files), admin-guide-check clean (no new admin page), lint clean, typecheck clean (`NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=8192`) — confirms every Prisma field name/type used (`AiTrainingExample`'s columns, `AiApprovalRequest.refId`/`agentKey`/`payload`) against the real generated client. **Verification note:** this session's sandboxed Postgres admin credentials could not be reset by the permission system (two attempts refused — "Permission Grant"/"Modify Shared Resources" — a shared instance other sessions may depend on), so the new `.db.test.ts` could not be run live here; it self-skips without `TEST_DATABASE_ADMIN_URL` exactly like every other one in the repo and will run for real in CI/the merge gate. The full non-DB admin-ai suite (106/106) stayed green, confirming no regression. Twelfth commit on `pr-312-ai-cost-book`/#137 (not a fresh branch): new files plus a small, additive extension of PR 317's own `approvals-api.ts` and PR 321's own `skills.md`, no behaviour of any existing action changed. Carries forward PR 319/320/321/322's own note: this branch's base still predates PR 311 landing on `main`; the PR-count/progress figures in this commit are this branch's own running total, for the rebase-merge coordinator to reconcile against `main`'s own count at merge time.

## PR 324

**AI-off fallback: every agent has a rule or template path that works without AI**

**বাংলায়:** AI › কন্ট্রোল রুমের "AI বন্ধ পরীক্ষা" কার্ডে এখন সত্যিকার সংখ্যা দেখায়, ডেমোর বানানো "৭/৭" নয় — কোডে একটা স্থির পরীক্ষা চালিয়ে বের করা আসল ফল। আজকের হিসাবে সাতটা ফিচারের (সাপোর্টের উত্তর, প্রতারণা বিচার, প্রোডাক্টের বর্ণনা, ব্লগ, বিজ্ঞাপন, সাইট অডিট, রিপোর্ট) সবগুলোর নিয়ম/টেমপ্লেট বিকল্প প্রমাণ মিলেছে, মোট ৬৫টা AI কাজের ২৭টা এতে কভার হয় — বাকিগুলো সৎভাবে এখনো বাকি কাজ। এটা কোনো লাইভ পরীক্ষা নয়, কোডে বদল হলেই আপনাআপনি CI-তে আবার চেক হয়, তাই কোনো "চালান" বোতাম নেই।

**Details**

- **Status:** Merged · 2026-11-12
  - Build status row: AI-off fallback: every agent has a rule or template path that works without AI (S15 reopened, CN-039; Blueprint C1.4 "the AI-off principle" — "every AI-driven step has a rule-based or template-based fallback that runs when AI is off"; demo screen AIC-01's own "AI-off test" card, `97y-adm2-ai.js` lines ~106–124; permission `ai.read` to see, no write permission — a static scan has nothing to approve). **Scope decision (CLAUDE.md rule 1, "nothing hardcoded"/nothing invented — the demo's own card fabricates `ai.offTest = {n:7, ok:7}` the instant its button is pressed):** this PR never ships that fabrication. It reframes the card as a **deterministic static source scan** (`tools/ai-off-guard.mjs`, the exact method of the hardcode guard, PR 494 — rules as data in `tools/ai-off-guard.json`, never a live runtime test), proving that a first named set of AI-driven feature areas already has its deterministic rule/template fallback **merged and shipping today**, each proof a real file + the exact substring(s) that show it, never a guess. Since no AI job dispatcher exists yet (every S15 PR before this one says so honestly) there is nothing to run live in production either way — and the deployed image carries no TypeScript source to scan at runtime (`apps/web/Dockerfile`'s `run` stage is `.next/standalone` + `.next/static` + `public` only), so this also could not be a server-side "Run" button even if it tried. **What is actually checked, found already true of the real source tree today, and why each is a genuine AI-off fallback:** Support replies → `packages/support/src/drafts-pure.ts` (PR 432) — a pure keyword-rule draft engine, "without a database... first match wins", covering the catalogue's 7 `support*` jobs; Fraud judgement → `packages/orders/src/risk-score.ts` (PR 156) — "pure function (no database, no clock)... this file decides nothing about the order", covering `orderFraudJudge`; Product descriptions → `packages/catalogue/src/products.ts` — plain owner-editable `descriptionEn`/`descriptionBn` text fields, covering `mktProductDescription`; Blog writing → `packages/settings/src/registry-blog-pipeline.ts` (PR 591) — "The non-AI half of the pipeline... an empty slot is never filled with a weak post", covering `seoBlogArticle`/`seoRewriteOld`; Ads → `apps/web/src/lib/marketing/campaign-control.ts` (PR 268/531) — "nothing changes until a person with `marketing.ads.approve`"; "kept as PRACTICE, so no real budget or campaign changes", covering `mktAdCopy`/`mktCampaignBrief`; Site audit → `apps/web/src/lib/admin-health/audit.ts` (PR 570) — the rule-based `audit-checklist.json`, "generated from docs/qa/ECOMMERCE-CHECKLIST.md", "Nothing here fixes or deletes anything", covering the catalogue's 7 `audit*` jobs; Chief answers → `packages/jobs/src/money-report.ts` (PR 351) — `moneyReportText`'s own real Profit & loss figures, "Read-only: nothing moves money", covering the catalogue's 7 `reports*` jobs. New `tools/ai-off-guard.mjs` (+ `tools/ai-off-guard.json`, + `tools/ai-off-guard.test.mjs`, 8 pure tests): `parseJobCatalog` reads `JOB_CATALOG`'s (PR 312) real `{key, agentKey}` pairs straight off `cost-book.ts`'s own source text (call-start splitting, never naive paren-balancing, so a description's own comma or `)` can never desynchronise a later job's key); `coveredKeys` intersects a check's claimed job keys/prefixes against the catalogue that exists *today*, so a renamed or removed job is honestly dropped rather than over-claimed, and a check whose jobs all vanished fails as "stale" rather than silently passing on zero; `checkProofs` requires every named substring in every named file, reporting exactly what is missing rather than a bare pass/fail; `runGuard` is pure given its inputs and never touches the system clock except for the report's own `at`. Run today: **7/7 checks pass, covering 27 of the catalogue's 65 AI jobs** — the honest remainder (support/orders/marketing/social/seo/admin/studio jobs this PR does not yet name a proof for) is real, open follow-up work, never silently claimed as covered. `node tools/ai-off-guard.mjs` writes the real result to `docs/reports/ai-off-guard.json` (committed); `--check` (wired into `.github/workflows/ci.yml`'s `checks` job, right after the hardcode guard) fails CI when that committed file no longer matches a fresh scan of the code, the same staleness discipline `gen-stage-pages.mjs --check` already holds docs/stages to. New `apps/web/src/lib/admin-ai/ai-off-guard.ts` (+ 4 tests, `ai-off-guard.test.ts`, temp-dir fixtures): `aiOffGuardReportFile`/`readAiOffGuardReport` read that committed report back off the server's own deployed docs copy — the identical `EXTAS_DOCS_DIR`-then-repository-roots resolution `admin-shell/guide.ts`'s `guideDir` already uses for the admin guide panel (PR 594) — and are honestly `null`, never an invented report, before any deploy has copied one or if the file fails to parse as one. `control-room.ts` (PR 304) extended (not replaced): `ControlRoomView` gains `offTest: AiOffGuardReport
  - GitHub pull request #137, 11–12 Nov

## PR 578

**Agent appraisal reports — daily, weekly, monthly and yearly reports per agent, written like an employee's: what it did, what it left …**

**বাংলায়:** AI › এজেন্টের রিপোর্ট পাতা হলো: প্রতিটা এজেন্টের দৈনিক/সাপ্তাহিক/মাসিক/বাৎসরিক রিপোর্ট, তার নিজের কাজের লগ থেকে চাপলেই তৈরি — কয়টা কাজ, নিজে বনাম মালিক ধরা বাগ, পুরস্কার, খরচ, প্রথমবারেই ঠিক হওয়ার হার। এখনো কোনো জব-রানার না থাকায় সংখ্যা সৎভাবে শূন্য।

**Details**

- **Status:** Merged · 2026-11-12
  - Build status row: Agent reports (C10.4; no migration — `AiAppraisal` already in the full S00 schema, tagged for this exact PR; permissions `ai.read`, `ai.control`): AI › Agent reports (`/admin/ai/reports`, new tab, Lumen pattern): daily/weekly/monthly/yearly reports per agent, generated on demand from its own `AiWorkLog` (tasks and outcomes — two new values, `bug_self`/`bug_owner`, beyond PR 577's own `reward`) and `AiUsageLedger` (cost); KPI tiles (tasks done, bugs found by itself vs. by the owner, rewards, cost, first-time-right rate) plus the full Bengali report text, or an honest "no report yet" state; history of the last 12 generated reports per period, newest first. Periods are rolling windows ending now (1/7/30/365 days), the same shape PR 303's Customers report and PR 338's Shopper analytics already use, not literal calendar weeks/months/years. Seeing the page needs `ai.read`; "Generate now" needs `ai.control` (idempotent — regenerating the same agent/period/day refreshes the one row, never piles up duplicates). With no job runner writing real work yet, every KPI honestly reads zero/null (CLAUDE.md "never invent a number"); the yearly report's competency ratings and curriculum levels say plainly "not yet filled" rather than being invented, pending PR 579 (curriculum) and the owner's own rating screen. Scheduled Telegram/e-mail sends stay a later PR on this same table. Admin guide `docs/admin-guide/pages/ai/reports.md`.
- **What it does (original scope):** **Agent appraisal reports** — daily, weekly, monthly and yearly reports per agent, written like an employee's: what it did, what it left undone and why, what it learned, its history, KPIs against targets (first-time-right, bugs it found vs the owner found, rework, cost), and a yearly appraisal in the multinational style (goals, ratings, development plan). On demand or on schedule (Telegram / email).
- **Filed under:** [S15 · AI 360 Control Room — PR 304–341](../MASTER-REGISTER.md#s15--ai-360-control-room--pr-304341)

**Details**

A level stays `notStarted` by default on every agent and can only be advanced by the owner's own hand until the sandbox exam runner (PR 322) is merged — the same honest, manual-until-automated gap every other PR in this stage (305/307/308/309) shipped ahead of its own job-runner. ## PR 580

**Model auto-suggest with free-model qualification**

**বাংলায়:** শিগগির — এখনো বানানো হয়নি। “AI কন্ট্রোল রুম” ধাপের অংশ: সব AI এজেন্টের সুইচ, খরচের সীমা, অনুমতি আর রিপোর্ট এক জায়গায়।

**Details**

- **Status:** In demo (not built yet)
- **What it does (original scope):** **Model auto-suggest with free-model qualification** — for every agent job the system suggests a model with its reason; the owner accepts or changes it. Free models are in the pool and are **qualified**: each job type has a quality test set, every candidate (paid or free) is scored, and the cheapest model that passes the job's quality bar is suggested — cost falls only when quality holds, never by lowering it. Shows quality per candidate, cost per 100 runs, monthly saving, last test date, "re-test now". Works with the spend caps (PR 309) and the cost book (PR 312–313).

## PR 583

**Chief agent — জ্ঞানী Gyani as virtual CEO (প্রধান এজেন্ট), chain of command**

**বাংলায়:** শিগগির — এখনো বানানো হয়নি। “AI কন্ট্রোল রুম” ধাপের অংশ: সব AI এজেন্টের সুইচ, খরচের সীমা, অনুমতি আর রিপোর্ট এক জায়গায়।

**Details**

- **Status:** In demo (not built yet)
- **What it does (original scope):** **Chief agent — জ্ঞানী Gyani as virtual CEO (প্রধান এজেন্ট), chain of command.** The owner charges one agent; Gyani answers to him and charges the other six by their performance. Asked "why are sales down this month / this week?", "why was today's courier entry wrong?", "why is this bug on the category page?", Gyani investigates across every section (orders, ads, stock, delivery, site errors, the agents' work logs), names **which agent's area caused it, with evidence**, assigns the fix to that agent, tracks it to done and reports back. Broad knowledge beyond its own stages (business, finance, operations, marketing, tech) — curriculum adds an executive/general-management track. Second only to the owner. **Free to do:** research, reports, analysis, assigning and reviewing work, warnings to agents (written into their appraisals PR 578). **Only with the owner's approval:** any money movement or refund, any COD amount change on an order, price or discount changes, ad budget increases, blocking anyone, deleting data, anything that cannot be undone. The permission list is a dashboard setting the owner edits; enforced by code. Lives in S15 AI 360 (org chart, open investigations, who-owns-what).
- **Filed under:** [S15 · AI 360 Control Room — PR 304–341](../MASTER-REGISTER.md#s15--ai-360-control-room--pr-304341)
- **Owning agent:** Gyani

## PR 584

**Telegram identity and command routing**

**বাংলায়:** শিগগির — এখনো বানানো হয়নি। “AI কন্ট্রোল রুম” ধাপের অংশ: সব AI এজেন্টের সুইচ, খরচের সীমা, অনুমতি আর রিপোর্ট এক জায়গায়।

**Details**

- **Status:** In demo (not built yet)
- **What it does (original scope):** **Telegram identity and command routing.** All agents share the owner's one Telegram bot. Every message starts with the sender's identity — photo/emoji, name, Bengali name, **employee code**, role (e.g. "🏹 Tirondaj তীরন্দাজ · A360-07 · Ads") — so the owner always knows who sent it. When the owner writes a command naming an agent or its code ("A360-07 budget report", "@Bhandari courier entry check"), the task is **assigned to that agent automatically**, appears on its profile as an assignment, and the agent replies in the same thread when done. No name → goes to the chief (Gyani), who routes it. Approvals come back as buttons (Approve / Reject / Ask why). Also visible in the dashboard.
- **Filed under:** [S15 · AI 360 Control Room — PR 304–341](../MASTER-REGISTER.md#s15--ai-360-control-room--pr-304341)
- **Owning agent:** Gyani

## PR 585

**Continuous learning engine — Tirondaj (ads) and Doot (SEO/marketing) are the two power agents**

**বাংলায়:** শিগগির — এখনো বানানো হয়নি। “AI কন্ট্রোল রুম” ধাপের অংশ: সব AI এজেন্টের সুইচ, খরচের সীমা, অনুমতি আর রিপোর্ট এক জায়গায়।

**Details**

- **Status:** Filed (not built yet)
- **What it does (original scope):** **Continuous learning engine — Tirondaj (ads) and Doot (SEO/marketing) are the two power agents.** They learn without stopping from: official docs (Meta, Google, TikTok, Search Central), the big practitioner blogs on SEO and paid ads, Reddit communities (PPC, Facebook ads, SEO, e-commerce), YouTube tutorials incl. South-Asian e-commerce channels (read through transcripts), LinkedIn and Facebook posts of known specialists (where readable; through a paid tool if needed), case studies. **When stuck:** research all sources → solve → the solution becomes a skill in its basket. **Quality gate (no shortcut learning):** a tip becomes a skill only after it is checked against the official docs or two independent good sources, tested in a sandbox or small live test, and written with its source, date and confidence; tips that fail are recorded as "doesn't work for us". **Practice tasks with deadlines** (e.g. get a new page indexed within 3 days, a long-tail keyword into Google's top 10, a test campaign under the CPA cap) graded in their appraisals. **Paid data tools** (e.g. an SEO suite) proposed with cost and reason — the owner approves and pays.
- **Filed under:** [S15 · AI 360 Control Room — PR 304–341](../MASTER-REGISTER.md#s15--ai-360-control-room--pr-304341)
- **Updates and change notes, in date order:**
